About EEA
  • Projects

    Stitching Light আলো দিয়ে গাঁথা

    Stitching Light is a textile and light installation exploring Bangladeshi women’s migration to the UK.

    Find out more
  • Vacancies

    Chair of Trustees (or co-Chair)

    Are you interested in using your skills and passion to help one of the UK’s leading outdoor arts companies continue its creative journey?

    Find out more
  • News

    Introducing Quingo Starlequinn!

    Triumph of Art was a huge success in collaboration with HeartnSoul we brought the fun to the procession with our Disco Puppet Quingo!

    Find out more
  • News

    Trainee Producers Impact Report

    Emergency Exit Arts have been running Trainee Producer Programmes for over 10 years. They allow local people to be directly involved in the development of creative projects

    Find out more

    Impact Report 2022-24

    We have just published our latest impact report covering the past two years, we're proud of the contribution we have made to the cultural sector and the partners and communities we work with.
